extracted.name: Coconut Rice
extracted.description: This sweet Coconut Rice recipe will take your meal to the next level! It is delicious, only requires 5 ingredients, and is ready in less than 30 minutes!
ingredient_lines: 1 1/2 cups canned unsweetened coconut milk ((shake the can before using))
2 cups Jasmine rice ((about 13 oz.), well rinsed and drained)
1/2 cup sweetened flaked coconut ((optional), lightly toasted)
instruction_lines: Combine 2 cups water, coconut milk, sugar, and salt in large saucepan. Bring to simmer, then stir in rice.
Return to a gently boil, cover, reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes.
Remove from heat and let stand 10 minutes. Remove lid and fluff rice gently with a fork.
Transfer rice to a bowl; sprinkle with toasted coconut.
categories: what to eat with coconut rice
